name: Paseo del Prado and Buen Retiro, a landscape of Arts and Sciences
description: In the heart of Madrid, this landscape pairs the tree-lined Paseo del Prado, a boulevard begun in the 16th century and dotted with fountains like Cibeles and Neptuno, with the vast 120-hectare Buen Retiro park, once a royal palace's grounds. Nearby are a terraced botanical garden and grand buildings devoted to art and science, reflecting the Enlightenment ideal of sharing knowledge.
